subject: Implementation kickoff: streamed outputs, tool-calling & JSON schema alignment
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@mediq.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Streaming + functions + JSON output: scope and questions

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough earlier. We want to start scope planning for a pilot that exercises three things at once: (1) streaming token-level output for real-time UI, (2) function/tool-calling to enrich responses (database lookups, user-profile calls), and (3) strict structured output validation using JSON schemas to feed downstream systems.

Key context: our team will integrate Redwood into MediQ's triage UI and needs deterministic JSON payloads for downstream automation. Peak workload estimate: 250 concurrent real-time sessions (avg 60 tokens/sec). Security: we need to understand data retention and SOC2 controls before enabling test data in staging.

Can you: 
- Propose an MVP implementation plan with milestone owners and a 6-week target,
- Share a starter JSON schema and a preferred approach for streaming + tool-calls,
- Confirm what security evidence (SOC2, audit log export, retention settings) you can provide ahead of procurement.

I've attached a one-pager with integration requirements.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Integrations | MediQ Health
Attachment: mediq_integration_requirements.pdf

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@mediq.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-20T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Streaming + functions + JSON output: scope and questions

Alex — great summary, thanks. High level response and proposed plan below.

Short answer: yes, Redwood supports all three patterns in production: streaming with partial tokens, deterministic structured outputs via JSON schema enforcement + post-parse validation, and function/tool calling with guaranteed ordering and retry semantics.

Proposed MVP (6-week):
1) Week 0 (this week) — Kickoff & alignment: finalize schema owner, procurement contact, and sandbox access. Owner: Aditya (SE).
2) Week 1 — Schema lock & proto callbacks: deliver schema_template.json, run a 2-day validation pass with MediQ sample prompts. Owner: Marissa (CS).
3) Week 2–3 — Dev integration: function adapter + streaming client wiring, validate concurrency knobs in staging. Owner: MediQ dev lead; Redwood SE support during on-call windows.
4) Week 4 — Performance tuning: batching, prefix caching, quantization recommendations for cost. Owner: Redwood infra eng (TBD).
5) Week 5–6 — UAT & handover: run 5k end-to-end test calls, finalize SLOs and rollback policies. Owner: Marissa / MediQ PM.

Attachments: redwood_streaming_workbook_v1.xlsx (milestones + checkpoints) and schema_template.json (starter schema).

Security evidence we can provide ahead of procurement: SOC2 summary, exportable audit log runbook, and data-retention settings for sandbox. For production, we offer VPC/private deployments and KMS integrations. I can loop in our security contact if you want a detailed session.

Proposed kickoff times (PDT): Tue 2028-03-21 09:30 or Wed 2028-03-22 14:00. Which works for your team?

Next steps: please confirm kickoff slot, procurement contact, and any redlines in the starter schema.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_streaming_workbook_v1.xlsx; schema_template.json

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@mediq.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-21T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Streaming + functions + JSON output: scope and questions

Thanks Alex — excited to get this moving. Echoing Aditya's plan and adding a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to make owners and acceptance criteria explicit. Key items I want on the MAP:
- Schema ownership: MediQ locks schema v1 by end of Week 1 (Acceptance: sample payloads validated against schema).
- Sandbox tokens & test data: Redwood to provide scoped sandbox tokens + retention config for test environment.
- Security checkpoint: Redwood provides SOC2 summary + audit-log export instructions before signing.
- Performance gate: throughput validated at 250 concurrent sessions in staging with <150ms median tail latency for streaming chunks.

Risks & mitigations:
- PII in prompts — we'll provide a sample redaction policy and recommend client-side scrubbing for production.
- Tool call latency — recommend local cache layer for user-profile calls to avoid added tail latency.

I'm attaching a MAP draft and a short timeline doc. I'll take ownership of running the cross-team calls and tracking action items in the hubspot deal.

Proposed kickoff: Wed 2028-03-22 14:00 PDT works for me.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: mutual_action_plan_draft.docx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@mediq.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@mediq.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-21T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Streaming + functions + JSON output: scope and questions

Marissa / Aditya — thanks, that looks clean. We can lock schema v1 in Week 1. Procurement contact is procurement@mediq.com for contract and initial attestation. A couple of clarifications from our security team:
- Can Redwood provide a short SOC2 one-pager and a sample audit-log export (anonymized) before the kickoff?
- What retention options exist for sandbox logs vs. production logs (we'd prefer 7 days in sandbox, 90 days in production initially).
- For function/tool calls, can Redwood surface per-call metrics (latency, success/failure) per API call so we can bake alerts into our observability?

We also need a DocuSign flow for the SOW + addendum. I'll loop procurement in separately. Attaching our security questionnaire to help prioritize the artifacts.

On the kickoff slot — Wed 2028-03-22 14:00 PDT is confirmed for MediQ.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Integrations | MediQ Health
Attachment: mediq_security_questionnaire.xlsx

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@mediq.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-22T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Streaming + functions + JSON output: scope and questions

Perfect — thanks for confirming the slot. Quick checklist before Wed's kickoff:
1) Procurement contact: procurement@mediq.com (Aditya to send SOW+DocuSign link).
2) Security artifacts: I will share SOC2 one-pager and an anonymized audit-log export sample by EOD 2028-03-21.
3) Sandbox retention: default 7 days (we'll confirm retention settings in the kickoff and can extend to 30/90 for a longer trial).
4) Per-call metrics: yes — we emit per-request latency and success/failure metrics, plus token-level breakdowns in the console (we'll show instrumentation in the demo).

Meeting link & agenda (shared): https://cal.com/aditya/redwood-mediq-kickoff
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMediQ-onboarding

Top 3 agenda items for the kickoff:
- Schema lock and validation workflow (15m)
- Streaming client + tool-call wiring (25m)
- Security & procurement next steps (20m)

I'll prepare the SOC2 one-pager and the audit-log export sample and upload everything to the Drive before the meeting. See you Wed at 14:00 PDT.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
